The '''Ivax Nebula''' was a large [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] that encompassed much of [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], and created the [[Star/Legends|stars]] of the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]]. Accompanied by the [[Kiax Nebula/Legends|Kiax Nebula]] in the neighboring [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]] the two gas clouds are called the [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]].

==History==
Originally forming a coherent big cloud the Twin Nebulae were separated million years ago by a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] near present [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]]. After being discovered and charted by spacefaring species the nebulae were named after two ancient [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] trickster gods [[Ivax]] and [[Kiax (god)|Kiax]], because navigation proved difficult within the range of the gas clouds which caused trouble for many ships.<ref name="GG">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325web|text=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin|int=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin}}</ref>

At the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] most of the Ivax Nebula still wasn't explored. But this fact didn't prevent brokers like those at the [[Metellos Exchange]] on [[Metellos 3]] to sell the mining rights for promising planets within the nebula's range, including [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] extraction on some of the region's [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 36">[[Knights of the Old Republic 36|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 36]]</ref>

Thousands of years later mining pioneer [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] conducted several mining operations within the Twin Nebulae, starting at the planet [[Ione/Legends|Ione]] in the center of the Anoat sector. With this Figg succeeded over generations of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] cartographers, blazing new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] to [[Lutrillia/Legends|Lutrillia]] and [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]] through formerly uncharted areas of the nebula.<ref name="GG" />
